title: 10 Euro Silver Knights’ Tales Coin Set P
descriptionPlain: The complete Knights’ Tales series stored in a cardboard case that resembles a medieval treasure chest, this set contains all five silver coins, Chivalry, Adventure, Courage, Fortitude and Brotherhood, together with their corresponding certificates of authenticity. A coin set to delight both collectors and fans of the Middle Ages.This set has a size of approximately 14 x 11 x 10 cm.
